text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali chaired a cabinet meeting on agriculture policy on Wednesday.

- The government sets up ceiling retail prices for some foodstuffs such as beef, chicken, eggs and bananas during the fasting month of Ramadan due to start on Friday or Saturday. The measure is aimed at preventing price increases as demand for these utems is higher in Ramadan.
- Tunisia, Belgium sign accord to protect investors.
- British Foreign and Commonwealth Office Minister Jeremy Hanley arrived in Tunis on Wednesday for a three-day visit.
- Finance Ministry committee preparing a fiscal code.
